newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria seeks to lease nine medium-haul planes.
newsitem.headline: Algeria seeks to lease nine medium-haul planes.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned airline Air Algerie on Tuesday launched tenders to lease nine new medium- haul aircraft, the official news agency APS said.
It said six of the planes should be 150-seaters and three should each have 100 seats.

The bid is open only to aircraft manufacturers or leasing companies, excluding intermediaries, APS said. Offers should be sent to company headquarters in Algiers or its official agents in Paris, Geneva or London.
No closing date for the bids was given by the news agency.
